policy.run_counter_semantics: exact tuple equality; counter is 0 on the first box, so run>=24 begins on the 25th identical A box
policy.detector_prompt: first-frame init xywh normalized to frame size
policy.zero_detection: recorded abstention; candidate keeps its base box

control_definition.name: healthy_proxy
control_definition.rule: A_run<2 and B_run<2 and IoU(A,B)>=0.7; deterministic uniform sample within each target sequence
control_definition.warning: A/B agreement is a no-GT health proxy, not proof that either box is correct.
